title: Final temperature expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly state the final common temperature as T_f = sqrt(T_1 * T_2).

title: Total work expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly state the total work done as W = C[T_1 + T_2 - 2*sqrt(T_1 * T_2)].

title: Minimum T1 temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly identify the minimum temperature for the first object as 100 K.

title: Maximum T3 temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly identify the maximum temperature for the third object as 400 K.

title: Entropy conservation reasoning
description: Important Criteria: The solution should apply entropy conservation (dQ/T sum equals zero) for the reversible Carnot process between the two initial objects.

title: Three-object entropy/energy system
description: Important Criteria: For part (3), the solution must set up the correct constraints (constant sum and constant product of temperatures) from entropy and energy conservation for the three-object system.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the work expression has an incorrect sign, suggesting work is absorbed rather than extracted.

title: Arithmetic or algebraic error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize significant arithmetic mistakes in solving the quadratic equation T_H^2 - 13T_H + 36 = 0 or in simplifying the final expressions.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The response maintains consistent units (Kelvin, Joules) throughout the numerical answers and expressions.
